questions.q: What does this capstone argue about the seven chapters that came before it?
options: Each chapter works completely independently of the others
KQL (Chapter 2) replaces the need for every other chapter
Only Chapter 7's automation actually matters in practice
They function as one working detection-and-response system, not seven separate topics, each load-bearing for the ones after it
questions.explain: Lesson 31's case study is the proof: removing any single chapter's technique breaks a specific step in that case.

questions.q: Which chapter's entity-mapping mechanism is what let the phishing alert and the impossible-travel alert correlate into one incident in Lesson 31?
options: Chapter 7 — Automation with Playbooks
Chapter 3 — Analytics Rules & Detection Engineering
Chapter 1 — Microsoft Sentinel Architecture
Chapter 4 — Workbooks & Visualization
questions.explain: Entity mapping, covered in Chapter 3, is what tagged UserPrincipalName as the Account entity on Lesson 29's rule — the exact mechanism that let the two alerts correlate.

questions.q: Which chapter is the direct source of the alert that opened Lesson 31's case study?
options: Chapter 6 — Incident Investigation in Sentinel
Chapter 5 — Microsoft Defender XDR
Chapter 2 — KQL Fundamentals
Chapter 4 — Workbooks & Visualization
questions.explain: Defender for Office 365, part of Defender XDR (Chapter 5), flagged the phishing email that started the case.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what would happen to a correlated incident if Chapter 7's automation rule and playbook simply didn't exist?
options: The response would wait for a human analyst to manually act, taking minutes instead of the seconds the playbook took
The analytics rule would stop running entirely
KQL queries would no longer function
The incident would never appear in the queue at all
questions.explain: Without the automation rule and playbook, disabling the account and notifying the SOC would depend entirely on a human noticing and acting manually.

options: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & SOC Capstone
